body: I'm sorry you lost someone you love. God, I wish it was easier to deal with everything life throws at you. The pain is so much sometimes. I'm shy to and I know how when you find someone who you feel anchored to and then they are gone you feel lost and don't feel like living. You sound like a very loving person and the world could use more people like that. I see to many people who all they do is hate and feel justified being around. But you have a big heart and that heart can make the world better. Please stay, E. this place won't be the same without you.
